plan.planning_summary: Refining route_02 based on feedback directives from iteration_11 (best_target_score=0.7524) and iteration_13 regression (0.5717). Four routes explore: (1) focused 8-layer perturbation per directive, (2) full-layer damped optimization, (3) expanded 28-layer topology, (4) robustness-weighted objective. All routes initialize from iteration_11 best candidate thicknesses where applicable and maintain parent_route_id=route_02 per refinement_chain constraint.

routes.title: Eight-Layer Thick-Subset Perturbation with Damped Learning
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Phase-coupling effects in the 8 thickest layers dominate dual-band performance; constraining optimization to these layers with reduced learning rate will improve target_score without overshoot.
routes.design_principle: Selective parameter optimization reduces search space dimensionality while targeting layers with highest optical path contribution. Damped learning rate (0.05x) suppresses oscillation near local optima.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
design_variables: Thicknesses of 8 layers with largest values from iteration_11 best candidate; remaining 16 layers fixed
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
theory_basis: Needle optimization principle: localized thickness adjustments can refine multi-wavelength performance
Gradient descent with reduced step size improves convergence near optima
expected_advantages: Targeting thick layers addresses dominant phase contributions
Damped learning prevents overshoot observed in iteration_13
known_risks: Fixing 16 layers may prevent discovery of better global configuration
8-layer subset may not contain all critical phase-coupling layers
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_11 best candidate: [92.0, 45.0, 99.0, 120.0, 69.0, 120.0, 51.0, 120.0, 119.0, 46.0, 120.0, 45.0, 120.0, 47.0, 120.0, 60.0, 120.0, 84.0, 120.0, 65.0, 120.0, 75.0, 46.0, 70.0] nm. Identify the 8 layers with largest thickness values (indices: 3,5,7,10,12,14,16,18 all at 120.0 nm, then select next largest). Constrain optimization to perturb only these 8 layers; fix remaining 16 layers at initial values. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate scaled to 0.05x of default. Apply conservative acceptance: reject any step reducing best_target_score below 0.7524 (iteration_11 historical best) by more than 3%. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized, coherent TMM. Spectral bands: 200-400 nm (maximize reflectance), 800-1500 nm (maximize transmittance). Thickness tolerance: ±15 nm absolute normal deviation for robustness. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: reinitialize from iteration_11 baseline, reduce learning rate to 0.05x, constrain to 8 thickest layers, enforce 3% acceptance threshold below historical best.

routes.title: Full-Layer Damped Optimization from Iteration_11 Baseline
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Full-layer optimization with damped learning rate (0.05x) will outperform 8-layer subset by exploring coupled thickness adjustments across all layers while avoiding iteration_13 overshoot.
routes.design_principle: Reducing learning rate globally maintains search space completeness while suppressing parameter oscillation. Full-layer freedom captures inter-layer phase coupling that subset optimization may miss.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
design_variables: All 24 layer thicknesses with damped gradient descent
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
theory_basis: Gradient descent convergence improves with adaptive step size near optima
Non-quarter-wave optimization enables multi-band performance per needle technique literature
expected_advantages: Full-layer optimization captures global phase coupling
May discover configurations inaccessible to 8-layer subset
known_risks: Risk of local optima trapping despite damping
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Allow all 24 layer thicknesses to vary during optimization. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate scaled to 0.05x of default value. routes.revision_reason: Tests whether full-layer optimization with damping outperforms 8-layer subset; compares search space completeness vs. dimensionality reduction from route_02_refine_01.

routes.title: Expanded 28-Layer Topology with Quarter-Wave Seeding
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 24 to 28 (within 30-layer limit) provides additional degrees of freedom for dual-band optimization, enabling sharper band edges and higher performance.
routes.design_principle: More layers increase design space for spectral shaping. Quarter-wave seeding at band centers provides physically motivated initialization before non-quarter-wave refinement.
routes.proposed_topology: 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
4 additional layers increase deposition time but remain feasible
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory: more layer pairs increase reflectance bandwidth and magnitude
Needle optimization literature shows non-quarter-wave refinement improves multi-wavelength performance
expected_advantages: Additional 4 layers provide more phase control for dual-band shaping
May achieve sharper transition between UV stopband and SWIR passband
known_risks: More layers increase fabrication complexity and stress
May not improve performance if 24 layers already sufficient
Initialization from quarter-wave may bias toward local optima
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses using quarter-wave optical thickness at geometric mean of each band: UV band center 300 nm (HfO2 n≈2.1: 35.7 nm, SiO2 n≈1.5: 50 nm), SWIR band center 1150 nm (HfO2 n≈1.95: 147.4 nm, SiO2 n≈1.45: 198.3 nm). Use alternating pattern starting with HfO2. Allow all 28 layer thicknesses to vary during optimization. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with default learning rate. Apply conservative acceptance: reject any step reducing best_target_score below 0.7524 (iteration_11 historical best from 24-layer) by more than 3%. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized, coherent TMM. Spectral bands: 200-400 nm (maximize reflectance), 800-1500 nm (maximize transmittance). Thickness tolerance: ±15 nm absolute normal deviation for robustness. Thickness bounds: 30-200 nm per layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Tests whether layer count increase from 24 to 28 improves dual-band performance; complementary to route_02_refine_01/02 which maintain 24 layers.

routes.title: Robustness-Weighted Optimization with Iteration_11 Initialization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Weighting robustness_score alongside target_score during optimization will produce designs with better tolerance to thickness variation while maintaining acceptable spectral performance.
routes.design_principle: Multi-objective optimization balancing performance and manufacturability. Iteration_11 showed robustness_score ~0.42; improving this while maintaining target_score > 0.75 indicates more fabrication-tolerant design.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
design_variables: All 24 layer thicknesses with robustness-weighted objective
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
Maximize robustness_score under ±15 nm thickness tolerance
manufacturing_considerations: Materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
Design prioritizes tolerance to deposition variation
theory_basis: Robustness optimization accounts for fabrication uncertainty
Multi-objective evolutionary approaches balance competing performance metrics
expected_advantages: Identifies designs less sensitive to thickness variation
known_risks: Robustness weighting may reduce peak target_score
May converge to conservative designs with lower spectral performance
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_11 best candidate: [92.0, 45.0, 99.0, 120.0, 69.0, 120.0, 51.0, 120.0, 119.0, 46.0, 120.0, 45.0, 120.0, 47.0, 120.0, 60.0, 120.0, 84.0, 120.0, 65.0, 120.0, 75.0, 46.0, 70.0] nm. Allow all 24 layer thicknesses to vary. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with objective function weighted as: 0.7*target_score + 0.3*robustness_score. Apply conservative acceptance: reject any step reducing best_target_score below 0.7524 (iteration_11 historical best) by more than 3%. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized, coherent TMM. Spectral bands: 200-400 nm (maximize reflectance), 800-1500 nm (maximize transmittance). Thickness tolerance: ±15 nm absolute normal deviation for robustness calculation. Thickness bounds: 30-200 nm per layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Tests robustness-performance tradeoff; complementary to route_02_refine_01/02 which focus on target_score only. Addresses manufacturing tolerance concerns for UAV window application.
